f.title: Manufacturer: mark the report as supplemental or followup
f.statement: On a supplemental or followup report, the manufacturer must indicate that the report being submitted is a supplemental or followup report.

f.title: Manufacturer: cite the identification numbers of the report being updated
f.statement: On a supplemental or followup report, the manufacturer must submit the appropriate identification numbers of the report being updated (e.g. its original manufacturer report number and the user facility or importer report number of any report on which it was based), if applicable.
